parameters.query:
SELECT
    report_id,
    generated_at,
    dataset_scope,
    currency,
    period_start,
    period_end,
    payload
FROM analytics_reports
ORDER BY generated_at DESC, report_id DESC
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.analytics_report_files AS existing (
    report_id,
    filename,
    storage_path,
    content_type,
    file_size_bytes,
    checksum_sha256
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    $6
)

ON CONFLICT (storage_path)

DO UPDATE SET
    checksum_sha256 = EXCLUDED.checksum_sha256

WHERE
    existing.report_id = EXCLUDED.report_id

    AND existing.filename = EXCLUDED.filename

    AND existing.content_type = EXCLUDED.content_type

    AND existing.file_size_bytes = EXCLUDED.file_size_bytes

    AND (
        existing.checksum_sha256 IS NULL
        OR existing.checksum_sha256 = EXCLUDED.checksum_sha256
    )

RETURNING
    report_file_id,
    report_id,
    filename,
    storage_path,
    content_type,
    file_size_bytes,
    checksum_sha256,
    generated_at;
